Approved rule: One website store WEB01 in S01. PK unique within its source table; order/line common keys additionally include source + account.
Example / giải thích: Không gộp hai order chỉ vì cùng SKU.

Approved rule: Require customer_id for each website order in the initial schema; guest checkout is not modeled yet.
Example / giải thích: Không tự ghép khách Etsy/eBay theo email.

Approved rule: items_gross_amount = SUM(order_items.quantity × unit_price) for that order.
discount_amount = SUM(line_discount_amount); each line discount between 0 and quantity × unit_price. No separate order-level coupon in this initial subset.
Example / giải thích: S01 tất cả bằng 0. Nếu thêm coupon phải thiết kế lại allocation.

Approved rule: tax_amount = SUM(line_tax_amount) for this website subset; unit_price is before the modeled tax.
Example / giải thích: S01 thuế bằng 0; không cộng lại tax hai lần.

Approved rule: order_total_amount = items_gross_amount − discount_amount + shipping_amount + tax_amount.
Do not change a succeeded payment to unpaid because cancellation is approved; do not invent a refund transaction.
Example / giải thích: W1001 cuối S01: PAID + CANCELED, không có REFUND.

Approved rule: UNPAID/PAID does not model partial payment/refund or chargeback states. No code may claim those flows are covered yet.
Example / giải thích: PAYMENT/REFUND type reserved in approved baseline; S01 chỉ tạo PAYMENT/SUCCEEDED.

Approved rule: Initial scenario: NOT_REQUESTED → REQUESTED → CANCELED. Request PENDING → APPROVED. Approved REJECTED returns order cancellation to NOT_REQUESTED, retains rejected request.
Example / giải thích: Nhánh REJECTED mới là đã duyệt, chưa có fixture.

Approved rule: resolved_at is NULL while PENDING; required for APPROVED/REJECTED; resolved_at ≥ requested_at.
Only whole-order cancellation before shipment is modeled initially. Partial cancellation and cancellation after shipping require a separate rule/scenario.
Example / giải thích: Không ép hủy phần còn lại của eBay vào website contract này.

Approved rule: Keep purchase-time quantity, SKU, title and unit_price. Catalog edits and cancellation must not rewrite these historical purchase facts.
Example / giải thích: Đơn vẫn có quantity=2 và gross=40 sau hủy.

Approved rule: Relevant child mutation also updates orders.updated_at in the same transaction. Read header + child rows from one consistent database read.
Example / giải thích: Không ghép header cũ với cancellation request mới.

Approved rule: updated_at ≥ created_at when both exist; shipments delivered_at ≥ shipped_at; timezone mandatory. Equal timestamps can occur.
Example / giải thích: Cùng timestamp khác payload phải được phát hiện; không coi timestamp là version tuyệt đối.
Enforcement / scope: Validation; no new source revision field

Approved rule: shipment_items must link an item from the same order as the shipment. Sum allocated quantity per order line ≤ ordered quantity.
Example / giải thích: Ràng buộc liên bảng, không chỉ CHECK một dòng.

Approved rule: Approved initial website shipments table only records actually shipped parcels. It has no packing/draft parcels.
Example / giải thích: Website S01 có 0 shipments; NO_RECORD không phải shipment_id thật.

Approved rule: Initial subset has no hard deletion of orders/lines/payment/cancellation/shipment evidence. Products/variants can be deactivated.
Example / giải thích: Hard-delete/CDC semantics need a later design if introduced.

Approved rule: Use exact decimal(18,2) for website source monetary fields; S01 uses USD only. Other currency scales not yet supported.
Example / giải thích: Logical precision approved baseline, chưa chọn database engine.

Approved rule: PK/FK/NOT NULL and local bounds belong in the source schema; sums across rows and consistent status changes need transactional validation. Mirror essential checks in pipeline.
Example / giải thích: Không nói một SQL CHECK đơn lẻ giải quyết mọi quy tắc.

Approved rule: Retain raw invalid source evidence + exception; never silently fill a required ID, zero amount or success status.
Example / giải thích: Dữ liệu simulator hợp lệ phải pass; lỗi chủ động đưa vào test riêng.

Approved rule: Website current order: 1 row. History: exactly 3 observed versions at reads 09:03, 09:11, 09:15 for approved schedule.
Example / giải thích: Không tự tạo thêm history UNPAID tại 09:00.

Approved rule: This is a website-source schema approved baseline, not a complete warehouse schema or executable DDL/JSON Schema.
Example / giải thích: eBay/Etsy schema detailed review follows after website.
